Ayush implements until every response matches (contract tests + sim must stay green). Shapes marked [EXISTS] already work; [TODO] are Ayush's build list. To change a shape: BOTH agree, edit here first, then code.
auth: Real signed sessions — POST /auth/login returns an HMAC token bound to {tenant_id, role, base_role}. Send it as Authorization: Bearer on EVERY call (media URLs may use ?access_token=). Server rejects missing/forged/expired tokens (401), another tenant's tenant_id (403) and routes the role can't use (403). Roles: owner [*], manager [approve, hire, chat, artifacts], viewer [chat]. Public: /health, /auth/login, /public/*.
